protocol.baseline: Frozen dense-mlp128 raw logits, with its embedded original8640 scaler; only system column receives delta.

cache.progress: Atomic NaN initialization; every16 chunks flush/fsync and exact completed-prefix hashes.

protocol.zero_control: Full173032 frozen-p parity and decisions; original-threshold and same-helper-retuned metrics, not a candidate.
protocol.guards: Against original dense AND delta0-cache-retuned: original4 F1 loss<=.02, accuracy loss<=.01, full/tail F1 nondecrease,5profile FPR<=.05; tolerance1e-12.
protocol.promotion: Maximum mean F1 among dual-guard eligible candidates, strictly above max(two controls)+1e-12; otherwise diagnostic only.
protocol.portable: Raw8640+raw512; hash-bound frozen base; full173032 zero and nonzero checks, independent CPU check.
protocol.limitation: Development validation is reused. Both banks have identical rows but different LM extraction batches; this is not an isolated causal head ablation. Only the system logit changes. The other four raw logits, conditional probabilities and their internal argmax ordering remain unchanged; absolute probabilities, global argmax and CoT recall can change. Five-class CE has the same correction gradient as binary system-vs-nonsystem CE; the conditional non-system class loss is constant. A positive result needs new independent confirmation. Delta-zero numerical controls are not a third trained candidate.
